summary: User requested to delete/terminate the website (project cancellation).

existing_features.title: Implement a frontend "Site Retired" screen that replaces the normal app experience when the backend reports the site is retired, and ensure all routes (/, /text-to-image, /text-to-video, /text-to-voiceover, /my-history, /admin) render the retired screen for non-admin users.
Add an admin-only "Retire site" and "Purge all user data" control section to the existing Admin page, including a confirmation step to prevent accidental retirement/purge.
Choose and apply a coherent visual theme for the "Site Retired" experience (typography, spacing, and neutral color palette) and use it consistently on the retired screen and admin retirement section.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a canister-level "site retired" state that can be toggled by an administrator, and expose a public query to read the current site status (retired flag + optional public message).

When the site is retired, block all non-admin, non-status backend operations (e.g., generation history mutations/queries and profile operations) so the application behaves as effectively deleted from the user perspective.

Add an admin-only backend operation to purge all stored user data (user profiles and generation history) to support “delete this website” as a data wipe, and make it available only when the site is retired.

projectName: Retire (disable) the website and block access to all features
